items.headline: Commission takes a key step forward on 2027 financial support for Ukraine
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 30 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission took another step in the implementation of the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan, which will provide Ukraine with essential budgetary support and defence products in 2026 and 2027.

items.headline: UK extends facial recognition to civil immigration offences
items.summary: UK Immigration Enforcement is set to start deploying live facial recognition technology, but critics are concerned about the expansion of its biometric surveillance into non-criminal matters away from ports of entry, especially in light of underlying issues with the integrity of Home Office data.
